reviews.text:
I've been here twice already, unfortunately, this time with the dog.
I was a little worried because I read so many bad things, but I was positively disappointed.
The problem was serious, they helped very quickly and saved the dog's life. Everyone was very helpful.
Thank you for your work!

We went to see Dr. Eszter Vágó for dermatology. We would go to the ends of the earth to see her. We have only been going to her since we started having allergies. A phenomenal doctor with great expertise.
Everyone, from the receptionist to the pharmacist to the doctors and assistants: professional, kind, patient, and last but not least, they understand and love animals.

I recommend it to everyone from the bottom of my heart🙏🏻🐾

It is rare to find a place where not only expertise, but also humanity, kindness, attention and sincere love for animals can be felt so much.

Huge thanks and recognition go to the entire team! The doctors are extremely conscientious, thorough, patient and professionally prepared. It is noticeable that for them treating animals is not just a job, but a real vocation. ❤️

The assistants are fantastic, kind, attentive and helpful, their every move radiates love and care for animals.

And the reception staff also deserve the greatest praise! They are always kind, patient, helpful and contribute to making you feel in good hands from the first moment.

It is especially important that here they not only pay attention to the little pets, but also treat the owners' concerns with understanding and humanity.
I would like to thank the entire team for their hard work, dedication, patience and love! 🥰

I wish we could meet such an attitude in every veterinary institution!

I recommend it to everyone with all my heart! If someone is looking for a place where expertise and humanity go hand in hand, then this is the best place.

Thank you for being there and for doing your job with such love! ❤️🐶🐱
🐾KARCSI THE PUPPY 🐶
Very kind and professional doctors.

On Saturday, early in the morning, my little Yorkie needed urgent help. They greeted us immediately and we received professional, efficient and caring care without delay. They were very kind to the dog and to us.

We would like to express our gratitude to the Budapest Animal Hospital for the exemplary fast and correct care! We are very grateful to the assistant for the detailed information and help, and to Dr. Kinga Selymes for her outstanding professional knowledge and her extremely kind, professional attitude. We wholeheartedly recommend them to any owner in need!
We are very grateful to the doctors and nurses who worked here for saving my dog! I recommend the hospital to everyone, the highest level of professionalism is here and everyone is very helpful!

I would like to congratulate every single employee of the hospital who is doing what is going on there with complete lack of organization and mindlessness. Everyone goes there because they are worried about their little pet, but the fact that from 7 pm to 11 pm, everyone who arrived after us wouldn't even ask what's wrong with my cat is nonsense. It's all going on in a chaotic manner, everyone is running around outside, they're banging on the door, they're being called in first, and we're standing there as if nothing had happened to us. I would have slammed the door like that woman from Alpár, I didn't stoop to that level, we got home after a 4-hour wait and I'm staying awake with my feverish cat so I can take him to another vet in the morning, thank you very much for your professionalism 👏👏👏 But of course, in capital letters, the second sentence of the receptionist is that the night fee is 58,000 HUF from 8 pm (I didn't really care about the money because I'm a pet lover) but would you be interested in spending that much on this production or on that dirty waiting room? In 4 hours, I spent 1.5 million to go in, so 1-2 doctors would have made more😵😵‍💫 What goes on there is pathetic and I never want to go there again😵😵😵☠️☠️☠️
Such a dedicated, infinitely kind and empathetic doctor is rare, I recommend him wholeheartedly to everyone.. Kisgergely Judit, ophthalmologist

We went to see Dr. Tamás Vrabély for an examination, who did an ultrasound and an ECG on our dog. He was professional, kind and informed us correctly. The receptionist was also extremely kind and polite. I recommend the place.

We are eternally grateful to the entire staff who worked the night shift last night. We arrived not knowing that our condition was serious, we thought it was just a small matter, but the receptionist immediately, incredibly professionally and with all her heart assessed the problem. She immediately rushed our 16-year-old cat to the oxygen box to help him. This was followed by an extremely precise X-ray and ultrasound examination, which revealed extensive lung damage and severe pleural effusion. The doctor on duty was extremely fair, honest and extremely humane: he did not want to force unnecessary, expensive and prolonged suffering interventions on us, but told us everything based on pure reality. Although this is a night shift in the capital, and on the way out we saw that the waiting room was completely full, we didn't feel any of this inside: they were so tactful that they withdrew from the operating room to give us time and space to make the most difficult decision. They didn't rush anything. In the last, most painful minutes, they provided Skubi with such deep respect and peace that we can never be grateful to them enough. We thank them for their humanity and their high-level professional work.”
Accurate, kind, professional service.
Really nice and helpful staff.
We received very kind and professional care at the emergency room, thank you!!
Doctor Vrabély has earned our trust with his 40 years of experience and expertise in the profession. Thank you for your work!

On Saturday, July 25th, I brought my 15-year-old dog from Nógrád County in with watery diarrhea and dehydration, because another veterinary clinic that was open until 8 that day recommended them, saying that if the dog had to be kept indoors, the Animal Hospital could provide the appropriate treatment, and unfortunately our own doctor had not ordered it. I brought him in, they did a Giardia test, which came back negative, and they did an ultrasound and the head-scratching went away, saying that they didn't know what could be wrong with him, because there was no significant change, but he would definitely get an infusion. That went away, they prescribed him Nospat, Quamatel Mini, and Endia paste, then 65 thousand forints, and that we should come back tomorrow, but be prepared with 3 days of cold food. The next day we waited 3 hours, the dog's stool was already bloody, and he didn't improve at all. The doctor who treated him that day stated that she would not prescribe antibiotics because they would do more harm than good, but she also did not know what the dog's problem could be, because the dog's blood test was completely normal. He was given an infusion, and in the meantime the dog was already bleeding in the yard, he was so sick, to which they explained that this was only helping the dog's intestinal wall. They gave me a stool sample collection container, to collect for two days, but they told me in advance that it would take 3-4-5 days to get the results, all for 85 thousand forints... By Monday the dog was practically bleeding profusely, he was between life and death, by the time I got to our own doctor for the morning appointment, whose first thing was to give him an antibiotic injection. The dog was better by Tuesday, not thanks to the Animal Hospital, but because I took the dog to our own doctor every day for 5 days for antibiotics and infusion treatment... I don't care, they are a superficial, arrogant bunch, whom heaven forbid anyone, because if they had their way I could have brought the dog to them for anesthesia on Monday night, in agony. Our visit to the Animal Hospital cost 165 thousand forints + 30 thousand for medicine, half of which our own doctor left, saying that the kiss was dead. By the way, the entire treatment at our own doctor cost 17,500 forints, which was still useful... I wish these veterinarians would treat them with the same "efficiency" and professional care as my 15-year-old dog. Because asking for money is the way to go...

Reacting to the Animal Hospital's response: I would like to point out, believe me, that the dog got better as a result of the antibiotic treatment performed by our own veterinarian. What you provided was a routine, basic treatment, superficial, without considering the change in the dog's condition. You shouldn't experiment with an almost 15-year-old dog... You have received as much respect, and even more, than you deserve. I stand by what I have written, and I would like to point out that it is not by chance that you are receiving 1-star ratings in a row... maybe instead of arrogance, you should look into yourselves and examine your applied practice.
Conscientious and knowledgeable staff, they have fed several of our pets several times. Thank you
They are very nice.

We arrived on Sunday with an emergency, an open wound. After a 20-minute wait, we were greeted kindly, and then Dr. Barnabás Juhász and his assistant informed us that they would go back to take an X-ray, cut the hair off his leg, clean and disinfect it. Obviously paying a weekend surcharge, two days later it turned out at the local pet clinic that none of this had been done properly, and the wound had not been stitched up. It is outrageous to me that they are asking for so much money and that this amount does not allow my puppy to receive maximum care! They should be deeply ashamed of themselves, a pet is still in a vulnerable state…

Our dog's eye got inflamed in the evening.. unfortunately I couldn't reach a doctor. My husband went to the emergency room to get a prescription for eye drops. A "lady" came out and said that it was a night shift, they didn't work for free, it would be 68,000 HUF. Let's start there, that you couldn't even ask for money to write a prescription. Congratulations!!! But the animals come first, not the money! Disgusting gang!

We would like to thank the entire team at the Budapest Animal Hospital for the care of our dog. We visited the emergency room at night, where they received us very kindly, patiently and understandingly despite the late hours.
During the examination, they informed us that our dog would have to undergo a serious operation (a tumor had to be removed), which was performed the next day. The operation went well, the wound healed nicely and without any problems, and our dog has been in very good condition ever since.
I would like to especially thank Dr. Ákos Horváth for his work, who was very kind, empathetic and humane from the first, late night examination through the surgery. We are very grateful for the care and expertise with which he treated our dog!

I really, really thank you for the work of the staff there. My cat had to have surgery because the little idiot ate some sponge/rubber. They found out with an X-ray that there was something in his stomach that didn't belong there. Then they removed it during a gastric bypass. The whole thing happened very quickly, in two days. They did an efficient, fast, professional job. I thank Dr. Fischer for her kindness and attention. And I thank Dr. Sík for her work, who performed the surgery.

We arrived at the hospital at 11:30 at night (as it turned out for us after the examination) with a dog with a ruptured abscess. I would like to emphasize that the assistant and the doctor were incredibly professional and conscientious. They were kind and understanding with both the pets and the owners. The care was also thorough and professional. That's why I'm giving it two stars.
Everything else was criminal. We waited 6 hours and we weren't even the worst. There were people who waited 8 hours... But the worst thing was that a dog died while waiting! And I don't blame the workers for that. The assistant tried to do three things at once: she admitted new patients, helped the doctor, and took care of the pets that had already been treated but needed attention. When we finally got in, we helped her pack, put her down, and restrain the dog. Only at the bloodiest part, the assistant was able to come.
Half of the price of the treatment was the night surcharge and visit fee (58,000 HUF) and everything else came on top of that... I understand and accept that night duty is expensive, but then they should provide two doctors and two assistants so that they can provide patient care properly. I understand that most nights a doctor-an-assistant setup is enough, but reading the comments, it can't be that rare when this setup is not enough! And yes, the wait is "burdensome", too, for 6-8 hours, when you don't know what's happening, what to expect, you have no information, you just see that your pet is suffering and you are helpless. You can try it. It's 2026, if they can't provide enough staff (if it doesn't come from the night fees...), at least they should come up with something for patient information, because this is the worst, when they just keep people in the dark.
Once again, we would like to thank the doctor and the assistant for their work! And I wish the management successful development!

THANKS TO THEM, MY CAT ALMOST DIED AND SUFFERED FOR WEEKS! SHAME ON THEM! 😡
​I brought my 12-year-old cat here in May after her first bout of nausea and vomiting. Here we received the devastating diagnosis based on an ultrasound: lymphoma (intestinal cancer). The doctors here stated that her condition would only get worse and recommended that we slowly say goodbye to her and PUT HER OUT because there was no hope.
​But I refused to give up! I took her to another clinic, where they started treating her based on the lymphoma diagnosis they made here. Thanks to this misdiagnosis, my cat completely deteriorated within 4 weeks. This wrong diagnosis cost me a lot of anxiety, suffering and money!!
He barely ate, didn't poop, and in the end he was constantly vomiting, he was skin and bones, dehydrated and SUFFERING A LOT! In the last few days, he couldn't even stand on his feet, his body was starting to get cold, and he probably only had hours left to live.
​At the last minute, a conscientious team of doctors proved with an ultrasound that there was NO TRACE OF TUMOR!
​Immediate, life-saving surgery was needed, where the real reason was revealed: my cat's intestines were fused and encased. Because of this, no nutrients or fluids could pass through it - this caused the constant vomiting and slow death. Instead of a tumor, a blockage should have been noticed! During the surgery, the diseased part of the intestine was cut out, and the two healthy parts were sewn together.
​Today, a little over 3 weeks after the surgery, my cat is eating, drinking, pooping, peeing again 🙏, he got his life back and is getting stronger every day!
​All this while, according to you, I should have been put to sleep a long time ago! They tortured a defenseless animal for weeks due to a superficial, incorrect diagnosis and sentenced it to death. Shame on you for your professional irresponsibility! I DO NOT recommend this place to anyone who loves their pet!

Postscript: Unfortunately, I cannot respond to your answer, so I am writing here:
I asked the Doctor again after the first examination if it was definitely lymphoma? She told me that it was 90 percent and not to get my hopes up, but to slowly say goodbye to it, unfortunately it is getting worse. She was very adamant that it was intestinal cancer. Unfortunately, it did not happen as she described in her answer! My partner and I both cried there after the diagnosis and he didn't want to reassure us that there was still hope or anything like that. We were given 3 choices:
1. anesthesia, 2. oncology treatment 3. symptomatic treatment.
So no matter how he tries to make things look better, unfortunately that's how it happened!
I hope they don't make such a mistake again!!
Best regards: Mónika

We arrived for an ultrasound, they called us in on time, we received thorough information about the dog's condition, including recommended/not recommended procedures, and a few words of encouragement. The clinic was a bit overpriced, but overall I had a positive impression.

A huge thank you to the colleagues working in the emergency room, who tried beyond their means to help every pet there, when the other emergency room was overloaded and wouldn't even let new arrivals in. It was true that we had to wait a long time, but they constantly came to the waiting room and checked the condition of those there and triaged the new ones. Everyone we spoke to was conscientious, attentive and kind.
We sat and waited for a horrible 3 hours.

I would like to give a special thank you to Dr. Boitrelle Patricia. She treated both of my cats: one of them had urinary retention and the other one suffered from megacolon. She works to an extremely high standard, but at the same time is very kind, patient and compassionate.

My husband and I are both foreigners and she was extremely patient with us, while always being very kind and attentive to our cats. She always listened to us, explained everything clearly and made us feel very safe when our pets were sick.

She is the best veterinarian I have met in Hungary since we moved here. I thank her from the bottom of my heart! I recommend Dr. Boitrelle Patricia to all pet owners with all my heart and full conviction.

Our dog was sent in for overnight observation due to a complication after surgery, I was a little scared because of the negative opinions I read here, but when I went in I was completely reassured. 2026 08.10. There were two young ladies inside who were very kind to us. I left my puppy there for the night with a calm heart, and when I went to pick him up the next day there was no problem.

What a fantastic experience! Thayla got something stuck, and we rushed her to Budapest Animal Hospital. We didn’t have an appointment, but she was quickly evaluated and taken care of.
We came back the next day for another examination and had the same wonderful experience. The staff were incredibly kind, attentive, and caring throughout both visits.
A huge thank you to the entire team for taking such great care of Thayla and for treating her with so much love. We are truly grateful! ❤️🐾
We went at night with a 4-month-old sick kitten, they were kind and professional.

Everything was absolutely fine, the female doctor and the assistant were nice and treated my cat well. They came straight away and asked questions, and considering that it was a night shift, I didn't have to wait long. Thank you!🙏🏻
Pricey but worth every penny for your pet

This is terrible...
I booked an appointment for my guinea pig online in advance (there was such an option), but when I arrived with my pet in the 40+ degree heat, they said they don't accept guinea pigs. Then why was that option there??! And most importantly, when I got the SMS, no one noticed anything??! Poor piggy got completely stressed, I hope you are happy with yourselves! Do a better job!
Not professionals. I don't recommend it.
I was with my puppy Melory. She was examined by a very kind, understanding, and highly skilled doctor. I was satisfied with the examination and treatment.

We were 100% satisfied with the professionalism, expertise and attitude of Dr. Fischer Daniella. She knew the answer to all our questions clearly, she was very kind and helpful. The assistant colleague also did a perfect job. The next day, Dr. Varga Tekla also did a 100% job together with her assistant. We were also completely satisfied with them and Boxy the dog 😊 On the 3rd day, Dr. Boitrelle Patricia welcomed us, like the two other doctors, she also did a perfect job. Her attitude and helpfulness are exemplary.

I would like to thank Dr. Gergely Szőke and his assistant for their conscientious work.
They did everything they could, they even revived my dog. Unfortunately, they could not save the life of my dog ​​Blondy. Which was very terrible, because I lost my youngest child.
Thank you for everything: Tamás Oláh

The appointment booking service is not working, which is stressful and depressing because we booked an emergency appointment and were waiting for a control examination. No additional information was provided while we were waiting, although that is what should have been expected after the 1.5 hour delay. We are satisfied with the medical care
I've already visited the place with my two dogs. The people who work here love animals, the dogs, the bunnies, the cats, and the parrots weren't afraid here.

The staff were incredibly welcoming and professional!

Despite our cat being very difficult, the staff were incredibly patient and gentle! We felt completely at ease, and the communication in English (we're French) was perfect. A huge thank you! 😺🙏

After a day and a half, I was told that my dog ​​urgently needed blood. In my opinion, it was not my job to organize this, but the hospital’s, especially in the case of an animal in a life-threatening condition.

Despite this, I obtained the blood, and when I got there, I had to wait almost half an hour before they took it. It is incomprehensible to me that in such a situation, saving lives is not the priority.

I paid a lot of money for the treatments, but I still lost my dog. I am deeply disappointed because I felt that the financial aspects were more important than caring for the sick animal. I did not experience empathy and real help.

In retrospect, I feel that it was a huge mistake not to choose the István Street animal hospital. In recent months, I have heard similar, also very negative experiences about this place from several dog-owning friends.

I cannot recommend this hospital. I'm giving it one star because based on my own experience it was extremely disappointing for me. I hope other owners think carefully about where they take their beloved animals.
We were here with our cat, the doctors did everything they could.

I've been coming here for a long time.
I usually bring my dog ​​Lili here for nail trimming..I recommend Dr. Patriszia to everyone..She's very kind, she knows her stuff, she treats animals and people well.. ..:):):)
They knew what was wrong with the cat. They didn't tell us, they just scammed us out of a bunch of money.

I took my sick puppy to the vet. We had to wait a long time, my puppy was panting and barely breathing. The doctor didn’t even touch the dog, just looked at him and said that he had a heart condition and needed an ultrasound. Okay, that wouldn’t be a problem, but the first step would have been to at least take his temperature! Instead, he didn’t even touch the dog.
​I asked for a chest X-ray because I was afraid he had pneumonia because he could barely breathe. After the X-ray, the doctor said that his lungs were fine, there was no infection, and he only gave me painkillers. Even then, he kept insisting that a heart ultrasound was needed — I think just to get more money out of me. I was sure that there was something wrong with his lungs, but after looking at the X-ray, he insisted that it wasn’t pneumonia.
My puppy was still panting and choking, but they sent us home with only painkillers. We got home and within 3 hours my dog’s condition suddenly worsened. I had to take him to another clinic immediately, where they did another X-ray. The doctor there said his lungs were completely black from severe pneumonia. If my puppy had received the anti-inflammatory and oxygen in time, he would still be alive. This hospital misdiagnosed his condition because that old doctor was too lazy to even touch my dog!

Our cat in poor condition was brought here at night for lack of a better alternative. Although the prices are high, if the animals were treated properly, it wouldn't be a problem. Well, our cat spent 3 nights here, due to a bladder problem common in neutered male cats, their bladder was flushed several times, they gave her an infusion of everything, the rapid lab tests were performed both upon admission and before she came home. However, no more in-depth examinations were performed. From the cat, from which urine flowed through the catheter for 0-24 hours, no urine sample was taken, no such lab was performed, just as many other lower excretory system examinations were not performed, which one would expect in such a situation. We brought her home and they said she was fine, only the few stones that remained in her bladder needed to be dissolved with appropriate food. Poor thing is no longer alive a week later, she died of kidney failure. If they had worked for a moment to find out what was wrong with the cat, to cure it, it would have been discovered and it wouldn't have been such a big deal, but they just wanted it to be there, so we could spend money on it, and then tell it it was fine, so we could take it back soon...
Shame and disgrace!

Dear Animal Hospital!
Have you thought about whether someone who brings their pet there in the evening or at night is worried because something is wrong? I believe that there are urgent and complicated cases that should be the first….but a 5.5 hour wait with unsuccessful access is deeply frustrating.

These owners are all worried about a family member, and they are waiting for both the owner and the animal to come home. Nothing matters at this time, just that everyone is okay.
Still. At dawn, you have to stumble home disappointed and worried…. Because you still have a child, another animal, work… whatever

What is dedication in this?
What is humility? Kindness? Help?

There is no excuse for a 5.5 hour wait

Dr. Vivien Mihályi is the veterinarian that every pet owner wishes for their little pet in case of a health problem.

This is the second time we have seen her on night duty, and both times we have found her to be an exceptional professional who, in addition to being extremely professionally prepared, is also very kind and empathetic.

Despite working in the middle of a long and stressful night shift, she was patient, attentive and infinitely humane throughout. She treated our puppy wonderfully, radiated calmness, and you could feel that she truly cares about the fate of her little patients.

We are very grateful for her conscientious work and care. It is rare to find a veterinarian with such a high level of professional knowledge and such an exceptional human attitude. I recommend her wholeheartedly to everyone!

I have only had good experiences, we go to Dr. Judith Kisgergely, she is always very attentive, thorough, patient, and thanks to her expertise, my cat's eyes are in the best possible condition considering her illness, and she lives a full life. Thank you!

My nearly 15-year-old dog got sick last night. We were at Dr. H. Ákos's, and his professionalism did not convince me at all. In fact… This was the most serious of my several problems:

He outlined a few possible diagnoses in the context of a cursory examination. I mentioned to him several times about all the history and current symptoms that we had already been here and that the problem was with his sugar. Among other things, I informed him that a lab was done and why his own doctor had extremely low sugar. He didn't really listen to me, but despite that, he started the treatment with an infusion, although I had previously asked for the sugar level to be measured due to his age. The infusion ended and after the needle was removed, I asked more firmly. Finally, they sulked and measured him and looked at him in amazement at how extremely low it was. Because he did not measure the blood sugar level as part of a routine examination before connecting the infusion (so I drew his attention to it), the unfortunate 15-year-old dog had to be pricked again to give him a sugar solution with a syringe. Suddenly, the diagnosis became completely different compared to how much he insisted on what he said. His resentment that he did not get sick because of the problem he outlined was visible. He completely lost my professional trust in him. In this way, he can treat such a small animal irresponsibly, which could have caused a more serious problem. This professional attitude for 77,000 HUF is outrageous…
Our critically ill dog received very good care. We can only say the best about the hospital staff, both professionally and personally.

Unfortunately, we had to go up from the countryside on Sunday evening because our dog got stuck on the fence. Even after waiting for several hours, they were unable to accept him, but they took everyone else first, so the dog suffered there. So we got lost in the morning and took him somewhere else. Shame on you. But they are kind to people.
I have only had good experiences with the care!
The doctor was very kind and patient, thank you for your work!
The lady who helped us was nice.

Expensive, especially the nighttime surcharge… but that's true for all veterinary medicine…. Otherwise, I think they were thorough.
Although we arrived before 8am, we only managed to fit in the night shift….

We arrived at 10:30 at night with an 8-week-old rottweiler who was vomiting, had a stomachache, and hadn't drunk for 12 hours.
There were five people in front of us, they said half an hour/patient because there was only 1 doctor. There was no reception, no preliminary screening, no triage.
The parking lot is minimal, narrow, everything is paved, there is no chance to make the dog pee normally.
Instead, we went to Supervet in Pesterzsébet, where we experienced the opposite of everything and were completely satisfied.
We had to wait a long time, but they were very kind and took great care of my puppy! I am grateful for their work.

What kind of “animal hospital” is one that, when an owner calls to ask if they can help their bunny get his or her oral medication after he has stopped eating, they tell him no because they are general veterinarians??
They shouldn’t do surgery, they shouldn’t even put a stethoscope on that unfortunate animal, they should just give it its medicine! This attitude is outrageous and they should think deeply about why they are in this profession and whether they should be in it at all…
They won't even do payment installments I told them my dog was dying they said I'm so sorry but we. Can't help if you can't pay!

I sat with the dog for 3 hours for nothing, there were many people, but during that time they didn't ask for my details! All this from 2 am, in the very dirty, cockroach-infested, bug-infested waiting room.. It's a wonder we didn't catch anything. Two stars because at least there is air conditioning and a bathroom. I never want to come here again.
I've been bringing my cats here for decades, never had any problems. They are always very kind and helpful.

If I could give a minus, I would.
Unfortunately, we had to go to the hospital at night with my puppy.
He has very serious intestinal inflammation, and our doctor recommended this place if he has a problem at night, we should take him here.
This place is a huge disappointment. Night, on call.. so that there is only 1 doctor??!
1, that is, 1 doctor who examines, who operates, who writes the papers.
They kept coming with sick pets. Many were sent away with the idea that the wait would be at least 6 hours, if it wasn't urgent they could go home. What is this??!
We "only" waited 4.5 hours for NOTHING!!
But there were some who had been sitting there for 6-7 hours.
The more urgent cases were called out of turn, which is completely okay, I agree with that.
But the whole thing is a complete joke!

We rushed in with a drowning cat around 2am, there were a lot of people, we knocked on the door just to get someone to look at it, but after 20 minutes no one came out of nowhere, so my daughter's cat died in her hands!😥 …
It was horrible, we waited two hours, and they knew my dog's condition was serious, but they told us we would have to wait an additional three hours.

A big thank you to both the doctors and the assistants!
My dog ​​Oliver was diagnosed with a terminal brain tumor in a week.
The expertise they provided despite their young age, as well as the thoroughness and kindness that characterized the nurses' work, is commendable. The doctors didn't start guessing, but escalated the problem and sent him to a specialist for further examination. During the infusion treatments, my dog ​​peed under himself several times, and the nurses immediately helped him without a word, wiped him off, and changed his diaper.
I've been here 10+ years ago, but I think the team is very conscientious now.
Thank you for your work, I hope my opinion reaches them.

Negligent, slow and few veterinarians are available to us even during the biggest problems! They prescribe the animals' medications very carelessly and do not investigate the source of the problem better, I am very sorry that this is the case, because this is the only clinic that is at our service 24/7.

amazing hospital with great doctors and nurses.
we came in the middle of the night with very sick dog, quickly got in, got very got treatment, follow ups and all our questions answered. highly recommend!

If I could, I would give it 0 points. I brought a tiny stray kitten in at night. After waiting for 2 hours, we still couldn't get in for an examination.
He couldn't breathe, which ended in screaming after straining.
A few minutes of rest, and he started all over again.
It was terrifying.
In the meantime, a lady arrived with a choking dog. She banged on the door for a long time to somehow get in with the dog with a blue tongue.
There was a doctor on duty, of course he can't be divided into several parts, but I don't understand why more doctors or even nurses can't be called on duty.
So the next urgent case can die in the waiting room.

We arrived at the emergency room with our large dog at around 3am today due to bloody vomiting. He was immediately admitted, had an ultrasound, was carefully examined, and received his medication infusion treatment. Dr. Tekla Varga and her colleague treated us with amazing patience and kindness, even though there were a number of critically ill pets arriving, who also needed immediate care!
We are very grateful for the help!

Our 17-year-old puppy had a stroke on Saturday morning. His left hind leg was affected. We got there at 5 am, luckily no one was there. Within 20 minutes, the necessary infusion was already running. He had to get it 3 times, by Monday the puppy was back to normal. They were very kind.

The receptionists were very attentive. We had a urological appointment with our Hungarian Vizsla at Dr. Balázs Bende. He treated our dog with infinite kindness, patience, precision and high expertise. I wholeheartedly recommend him to all owners.

Dear Solti Virág!
We are sorry to read your review, but we did not find an owner with that name in our records. Please write to us by e-mail (allatkorhazbudapesti@gmail.com) why you decided to give such a review!

We would like to thank Dr. Kinga Selymes and her colleague Szabina for what they did for our dog and for us. They were able to remain humane even under very difficult circumstances and operated on him at dawn. We waited, we waited a long time, but there were so many sick and difficult animals around us at night, we hope he recovers quickly.

Nonstop service. They don't answer the phone. You go there, knock, ring, no one is there. Then someone comes and tells you there's an operation, go somewhere else. Emergency care: go somewhere else urgently...
They charge a +20,000 HUF evening fee for 5 hours of queuing😂 …

Today we had an eyelid surgery with Sweety at Dr. Judit Kisgergely. I would like to share our own experiences, which were very positive.
Everyone was extremely kind and helpful to us.
I would like to thank Dr. Judit Kisgergely for her outstanding work, empathetic, patient and responsive attitude!
Not only was she extremely attentive to Sweety, but also to me every time. I am grateful to her and the assistants for the love and care they surrounded Sweety with.🙏🏽
She was observed for several hours and only handed over to me when they were completely sure that she was fine. They were very happy to bring her to me when she was in a stable condition and continued to monitor her condition in my presence. When she coughed THREE!! they rushed over to her to check if everything was okay with her.
I would like to especially highlight the reception staff, because I had read negative reviews before, so we were a little scared the first time we arrived. In comparison, we experienced the exact opposite: we were greeted kindly every time, we received detailed information about everything, and everyone turned to Sweety with love.
I also read criticism about the prices, but based on my own experience, I can't confirm this either. For example, one of the eye drops was more than 3,000 forints cheaper than in Budakeszi, where we had been before. And this is just one of my observations among many..
In addition, they always found a quick appointment for us, and when I indicated that we had to hurry, they were very flexible and helpful in taking us forward. Overall, the Lehel út Animal Hospital proved to be a fair, professionally prepared and humane place for us in every respect. We have only positive experiences with them.
Thank you for everything to Dr. Judit Kisgergely, the assistants and the entire team. I am very grateful to you! 🙏🏽🐶❤️
I would like to thank Dr S.Kigà for the invaluable care and compassion shown to our dog Hugo by his colleague and physiotherapist. Thank you 🙏. 🙏🙏 …
It's sad how incompetent the "doctors" are in this hospital, 0 knowledge, 0 help, but 5 in explanations and money-grubbing!!!! At best!! I don't recommend it to anyone!!

I give the hospital two stars with great enthusiasm... The hospital, as an institution, has passed its test. Last week, on Monday and Thursday, I left nearly 180,000 forints there, and another 60,000 in the pharmacy there. On Thursday night, my puppy drowned. We rushed there at midnight. A sign greeted us that a life-saving operation was taking place, and appointments would only be made from 3 a.m. We shouted, banged on the doors, and smashed the windows all around the building. There was not a soul in the building. My puppy drowned in my hands. I tried to resuscitate him on the table in the waiting room, but unfortunately, after 3 breaths, bloody, foamy juice came out of his nose and mouth. He was so traumatized that I felt sick......I would never wish this on anyone! I only give the two stars because one of the doctors and the cardiac ultrasound doctor did a very thorough job that afternoon. He was given heart medication that cost 35 thousand forints. In the afternoon, he was given half an eye and a diuretic. Maybe the medicine did something to him, but I will never know.
It is actually incomprehensible to me that the institution receives a lot of money from the tests and, as a 24-hour, on-call hospital, it allows itself not to have a doctor in the house at night. In fact, no one answers the phone, since there was no receptionist either. Amazing irresponsibility on the part of a hospital! I am still thinking about filing a complaint, although that will not bring my puppy back. 🥺🥺🥺🥺
Litle bit expensive

Professionalism, kindness, maximum helpfulness and support.
Everything was explained clearly, all our questions were answered.
We had an ultrasound and ECG at Dr. Vrabély's, we are very satisfied, thank you for the conscientious work!
We recommend them to everyone.

We left Dr. Vrabely with maximum satisfaction, after a pre-booked ultrasound examination.
He answered all my concerns reassuringly and the atmosphere was truly pleasant throughout.
I feel like a kind-hearted doctor with incredible experience and knowledge.
I recommend him to everyone!🐕🐾🐾

We arrived after eight o'clock in the evening.
My puppy jumped off the bed and fell badly.
He didn't break his leg but he whined, which is not typical for him. I was very scared and took him in immediately. Everyone was kind and helpful.
What really shocked me was the price. The nightly fee was 58,000 -Ft. I agreed when they told me because my puppy is part of the family.
I think it's absurd, twenty thousand forints would be more than enough, it's not a small amount of money. And this price only includes checking the animal. By the time we got to the clinic, he was already standing on his own two feet and not crying. He also received an injection, which was also expensive. It was already a few thousand forints, not bad.
Thinking about how much a doctor studies and comes at night, I still find this place very expensive. That's why I'm giving this feedback.
However, the Dr. and the assistant were helpful and very nice, kind and humane.

A friend of mine brought his pet here with an extremely urgent case. Although the call was a little slow (they could improve on that), the service is very professional. That's why I'm giving it the second star.

What it doesn't deserve more for is the unethical business model. Weekend fee, assistant fee? This part was just invented to rip people off, while veterinary services are still terribly expensive because they work with an incredibly high margin.

If the animal has a problem that could lead to death on the weekend, but the person doesn't have the money, then let it die or go bankrupt from which it will be difficult to recover? These are the two options specifically. And I'm not writing this because of a few thousand forints... this model is disgusting, how they rip off people in a vulnerable situation even more. It's not enough to pay for care and medicines for hundreds of thousands, and to pay a fee for nothing, because the animal got sick over the weekend and could die.
Health is not something we can time, neither for humans nor for animals. Of course, it's a great thing that they are open 24/7 and their work is to be appreciated, but profiting from families in trouble is something I can't agree with.

We arrived at the hospital late last night, my puppy was crying a lot, his ears hurt, he had a lump in his throat. When we got there, there were already a lot of people, a gentleman said he would read the chip right away. It didn't happen in an hour. And about another suffocating dog, the gentleman said he might not fit in the oxygen tent. What kind of attitude is this??? At that point, some of us got up and went to another place, where an operation was going on, but they were very kind. I have heard a lot of bad opinions before about how degrading the doctors here are, I am very sorry, because there are 3 night shifts in Budapest, you are unable to provide normal care at a horror price...
We will not go here again and I will not recommend it to anyone else.

Yesterday we went to the Animal Hospital with our 15-year-old cat, who suddenly became very ill. They were very kind throughout, both the doctor (Dr. Varga Tekla) and the assistant, as well as the ultrasound doctor who came back to the office for us. Unfortunately, our cat was beyond saving, we had to let her go. Both doctors and the assistant were very empathetic, kind, and gave us time to process the situation. Besides the fact that we were extremely saddened that Lili the cat had to be let go, I can only say positive things about the hospital staff. Thank you for your empathetic attitude.

Last night, unfortunately, we also got a couple of ear mites in our ears! I immediately rushed to Lehel Road, although we waited for an hour, because there was an injured dog inside too!
After we went in, the doctor quickly found one in his ear, but unfortunately the other one was very deep, so he took it out of my little dog's ear while he was sedated! He was very kind the whole time and treated it professionally, so the incident will only remain a bad memory for us!
Thank you very much to Dr. Ákos Horváth and the little assistant lady! 🥰Everyone, watch your dog, there are a lot of ear mites everywhere, and in an instant there is trouble!😏
They are very kind, excellent professionals.

On 28.05.2026. we arrived at 9 pm during the on-call time with our increasingly shivering, feverish, limping dog, who could barely walk. They immediately greeted him and in a few moments they realized that it could be nut (mold) poisoning. A quick gastric lavage, then an enviable amount of infusion to get him back on his feet as soon as possible :). After almost 4 hours it was clear that the danger had passed, but the dog was still there for observation, and we could come to pick him up the next day.

We would like to thank the night duty for the quick intervention, the professional and owner-friendly attitude!

I called my head off when there was a problem BUT! Ok, it's the only place where they could immediately accept me late at night.
They helped me immediately, they knew what was needed and the case ended successfully. I can only recommend them if I may say so in this case. They spoke with respect and patience, they were not in a hurry, but they did what needed to be done professionally and at a pace. I honestly say: I love them 👍 I wish everyone would consider being a doctor like them a profession!
Only go here if you really have to. They are thorough but very expensive!

We sat there with my cat from 8pm to 3/4am. During that time, they treated a total of 4 patients. And then they told us, and the other waiting people, that they had to go through surgery, which would take at least 2 hours, so we could come back at around 3pm, or go wherever we wanted that was open at night. They said sorry. And that was it. They sent me home.

I can't believe that the basic price of 58 thousand forints, which also includes any additional tests or treatments, doesn't include a doctor on duty. This insensitivity is outrageous and shameful.

(I also read the other reviews, the best one is when they start blaming the owner for not waiting 4 hours and taking the animal home. I never read a single apology, we made a mistake.)

We noticed that our cat's belly was bulging and we rushed here immediately. We had to wait a long time but a very kind young doctor greeted us who finally determined that a cyst had formed with pus. They took very good care of our little kitty and the doctor had such a strange case that he called us a few days later to ask how the cat was. They work for a high price but I can't say anything bad about it.

We had an ultrasound with Dr. Tamás Vrabély. He was very kind, patient, explained everything, and the examination was characterized by precision, expertise, and kindness. We went to him for prevention, because unfortunately we lost a small family member a few years ago because his illness was discovered late. If it is important to you that a highly knowledgeable doctor examines your little friend, then I can only recommend him!

They saved our dog's life <3 We arrived after 2 am with a stomach twist, and he was operated on at 3 am. We were very prepared, received thorough, detailed and correct information throughout the entire care process, and they answered all our questions patiently and empathetically. They called us every day to explain the current condition, and even sent photos and videos by e-mail. He is now recovering at home :) We are very grateful for their professional knowledge and humane attitude. Thank you!

I do not recommend this place. I brought my cat in with acute symptoms (balance disorder, pain). Although her condition improved after the evening appointment, during the afternoon check-up, while waiting, she developed severe shortness of breath. Intervention was performed (oxygen/painkillers), but instead of performing meaningful diagnostic tests (e.g. CT, X-ray) to find out the underlying cause, they just kept her in for observation overnight. At dawn, I only received the tragic news that euthanasia was necessary.

When I asked for an explanation later, the doctor gave a completely frivolous reason (weather front and air pressure) for the cat's death, and then turned the conversation to financial matters. In addition, we felt that the focus was more on the costs than on getting clear answers and a comprehensive examination regarding our cat's condition.
They are direct, understanding, helpful!
The doctor was very helpful. He quickly did the ultrasound we went for. He is simply a great doctor. He is patient, calm, understanding and extremely correct. I am very grateful. Thank you

Disgusting place I got an anti-diarrhea injection for 76 thousand last night they said they couldn't see anything in my stomach I took it to another place and had to have surgery immediately. Never again

We went in with our sick dog in a complete panic (suspected of epilepsy), they immediately treated the dog, it turned out that he had poisoning. Everyone was very kind, polite and helpful! Maximum professionalism and supportive atmosphere. Thank you very much and our dog thanks you very much too! 🐕🐾 …
We have been to Dr. Vrabély's for a cardiac ultrasound several times. He is a kind, highly qualified doctor. I can only recommend him.
Everything went well. I was called in for an examination at the scheduled time. We were able to arrange an unscheduled blood test. Thank you.
How kind of you to delete the negative comment :)

I wish there were sanctions for the amount of money a doctor's office charges for a fake treatment, and I wish there were liability if someone does not properly care for an animal. A worried owner turns to the veterinarian with trust and for help because he wants his puppy to be better. In such cases, there is no consideration, only the hope that it will be in good hands. Unfortunately, this is not what we experienced. As a layman, I believe that a vitamin B, salt water infusion is not enough for a dog whose circulation stopped shortly before arriving at the office, and then fortunately restarted. Although he walked to the office on his own two feet, his condition was clearly serious. We also know that no one is omnipotent, but we feel that this was not enough. Unfortunately, we lost the puppy two days later...
(Chasing butterflies over the rainbow) This
loss is incomprehensible in itself, but the
circumstances make it even harder to accept.
I wish whoever chooses this profession would fight for all animals
with heart and soul!
#idesohatobbet

On Sunday we were with our 5 month old puppy with diarrhea and vomiting. Dr. Barnabás Juhász was the examining doctor who determined that the puppy had enteritis. He received an infusion and then we came home. Unfortunately, our puppy did not get better, he did not eat or drink and became even worse, so we took him to another clinic where they diagnosed him with parvo despite the fact that he was vaccinated! Currently our puppy is in the hospital where they are trying to save his life! Without any malice, we think that the dr. has no practice or was just a fool!? This was around noon on 2026.04.26, I am writing the exact date because Parvo is terribly contagious and there were quite a few puppies in the clinic and they came after us, so anyone who came after us and is under 1 year old should pay close attention to that puppy because we think that the clinic did not notify anyone who might be affected!! It would have been nice if they would let us call to see how our dog is doing and if he's still alive!!!

Unfortunately, we didn't even get to medical care, because we left because of what we experienced at the reception.
I think that farmers arrive at a veterinary hospital worried and vulnerable, so a reassuring atmosphere would be essential. Instead, we experienced disinterest and lack of empathy from the receptionist. She couldn't give concrete answers, handled the data inaccurately, and made us feel like our presence was a nuisance.
I didn't feel that the bathroom was hygienic enough, which is what you would expect from an expensive private institution. The atmosphere was so unfriendly that despite the emergency, we preferred to look for another veterinary hospital, even if we had to travel further. It would be worth putting more emphasis on selecting the staff at the reception, since the very first impression and the trust of the farmers depend on their attitude.
They had absolutely no idea what was wrong with our dog!!!! It cost us 130 thousand unnecessarily.

I have mixed experiences with the place, but mostly negative. Last Sunday, I took my cat to the Lehel Street animal hospital because she was struggling a lot in the litter box, which had never happened before. The doctor felt her around, but no further examination was done because my cat was quite aggressively resisting and during the examination a dog had a seizure, whose care took priority - and rightly so. I was given an anti-inflammatory and sent home. The situation did not improve the next day, my cat had neither urine nor stool, but the lack of urine worried me more, because I know that in male cats this complaint can become very serious very quickly, so we went back to the hospital. The doctor (a different one) was much more thorough this time. Under anesthesia, an ultrasound, X-rays, and a small lab were done on the cat, their bladder was flushed and they also gave her an enema. They took a urine sample from him and sent it for further analysis. They let him go with the advice that if there was still no urine, we should go to another hospital. They gave us three options, Supervet, Fuziovet and another one, but that's not the point. Of course, nothing happened the next day and we had to go to the hospital again, but after reading the reviews of the hospitals given, I didn't feel confident at all. I decided to try another hospital and didn't take the cat to the hospital on Lehel Street, but to Csepel, where I trusted one of the doctors working there based on previous experiences. The doctor immediately determined based on the ultrasound that there were crystals and other deposits in the cat's bladder - we did not receive any information about this in Lehel Street, and then it was only on the urine sample paper evaluated on Thursday (taken on Monday), and on the X-ray the doctor discovered small foreign bodies in my cat's stomach - this was also completely new information, which the doctors in Lehel Street did not notice or did not consider noteworthy enough, which I consider unprecedented. My cat had a lot of urine drained from her at the Csepel Hospital, and then she was given a catheter so that we could resolve the drainage at home. I also received additional information about constipation: megacolon can develop due to the large amount of accumulated stool, which is quite dangerous, and I received detailed instructions on how to prevent this and what to do in the coming days. I also received extra laevolac to help the cat's bowel movements, as well as special food and paste that helps break down the crystals - I also never heard of such a thing on Lehel Street. The fact that such a thing exists came to light three days after the complaints started and we suffered at the doctor's office three days out of three - two of which were on Lehel Street, with two different doctors. I can't decide whether they just didn't notice these things or they intentionally omitted information so that the cat would have to be taken to the hospital as many times as possible for huge sums of money, but one possibility is worse than the other. There was hardly any mention of home care, nothing about possible consequences, complications, further dangers, and apart from a few pieces of preventive advice, I didn't receive comprehensive and detailed information. I don't know what's behind this, but neither the lack of preparation nor the intentional delay inspires much confidence. I think the hospital is adequate for emergency care, I wouldn't describe it all in detail, since my cat was examined and treated, but knowing what happened later, I wouldn't say I was at all satisfied with what we received. I probably should have been more assertive, but I went here believing that well-trained professionals would provide quality and comprehensive examination and care, and that the health of a pet would not depend on the assertiveness of a panicking owner.
Thank you for Baba's professional care!
Professionals

We took our cat there on 2023.04.23 on a Sunday morning because he couldn't stand on his hind legs and was suffering terribly. I didn't write about my experience at the time, but I realized that since I also search based on Google reviews, I should give back to the community. So what's late doesn't last.

No one should take their animal here, even for a simple routine vaccination. Total incompetence. The cat was uncooperative due to his serious pain, which I understand is difficult, but I would think that this is their profession and that's why they charge you a lot of money to know how to restrain an animal, even if it doesn't cooperate. Well, that didn't work here, they told us to restrain him until they gave him the painkiller. Well, needless to say, it wasn't a great success. When they took him out of the carrier, he was pulled out with one of his claws broken. After they gave him the injection with great difficulty, they said they were NOT WILLING to deal with him because he was over it and that we should take him somewhere else, but first we had to pay the more than 50 thousand forints. They didn't even give us a hint where to take him. So they didn't even examine him properly, we didn't find out what was wrong with him and sent us away. In the end, they helped us at Primavet, so the case wasn't unsolvable. If I remembered, I would even write down the doctor's name, just so everyone could avoid him.

The care was okay, but to have to pay 65 thousand for a two-minute general physical examination and a simple anti-nausea injection is a lot. I understand that it is a weekend and night, but this is very excessive. So that we had to wait 1 hour, because only one doctor was working. Two decades earlier, the experience was even more terrible, then a cat of mine died, indirectly related to the cause. Maybe the owner Hargitai should have gone to a politician or some kind of sports manager.

I wish there were sanctions for the amount of money a doctor's office charges for a supposedly prescribed treatment, and I wish there were liability for someone who does not properly care for an animal.
A worried owner turns to the vet with trust and for help because he wants his puppy to get better. In such cases, there is no consideration, only the hope that it will be in good hands.
Unfortunately, this is not what we experienced.
As a layman, I believe that a vitamin B, saline infusion is not enough for a dog whose circulation stopped shortly before arriving at the office, and then fortunately restarted. Although he walked to the office on his own two feet, his condition was clearly serious. We also know that no one is omnipotent, but we feel that this was not enough.
Unfortunately, we lost the puppy two days later… 💔He chases butterflies over the rainbow 🤍This loss is incomprehensible in itself, but it is even harder to accept due to the circumstances.
I wish whoever chooses this profession would fight with all their heart and soul for all animals!
#idesohatobbet
The best doctor Dr. Ákos Hotváth! Thank you for everything! But I never want to go there again! My sweet little angel Szuszókám🙏🏾😪🖤 …
They always give advice, they are kind. Thank you very much to them🙏 …
Perfect. They can help with everything!

The night-time emergency care is below par.
Don't you realize that most of the negative reviews are for this period? 1 doctor 1 assistant, no reception. There is apparently no emergency order. A large dog that doesn't move, drools, and gasps for air is kept waiting for 3 hours while 15-year-old cats are euthanized.
4 people took care of the dog in the XX. district animal shelter after we left.
We will never go there again and we don't recommend it.

If I could, I would give it -10 stars.
After our cat was neutered, we rushed in because of an infected wound, but what I experienced there made me decide never again! I would rather take her somewhere else than here again.
Dear Doctor, when we entered the room, after greeting her, I started to describe the problem. Interrupting my words, with an angry look, she looks at the person accompanying me and says in a very unpleasant voice: CLOSE THE DOOR AFTER YOU! I don't ask for anything, thank you, thank you. I believe it's a holiday, but if I'm leaving 46,000 HUF there, then I expect your kindness! Both she and I live from work, for which this is essential.
The next day I took her to another doctor, there they cleaned her wound again, also on a holiday, in the middle of a holiday, kindly, understandingly, as one would expect. The biggest surprise is that it only cost 14,000 .Ft. I ask are you sure? The doctor says yes, he's sorry the price is high, it's just supplements, I say no, no way, the price doesn't matter in this area. Just because he got an antibiotic injection, I was surprised.
It's not enough that they rip you off, even jerks. If the dear Doctor had been nice, she wouldn't even care.
First photo Bp Animal Hospital, second, a very tidy private clinic. Where they are nice too!

The hospital is professional. The doctors are nice. The girl at the reception named Friderika is the complete opposite. I asked her anything and she didn't know anything, couldn't give me any information, couldn't help me. However, her colleague Afrodite was very nice and helpful. I thank her for everything!
We came for an abdominal/chest ultrasound with our little dog and Dr. Tamás Vrabély did his job in an extremely kind and helpful manner.
I looked up exactly where it was located.
They are very nice ❤️

I took my dog ​​to them on Friday, because his belly was bigger than it should be, they did a blood test and an ultrasound, they found inflammation and treated him with a suspicion of a tick, I took him back on Saturday for an infusion, they removed it in two days for 130,000 HUF, on Sunday I took him to the Primavet 15th district, as the doctor put it on the table, she said she felt a tumor in his belly, the tests confirmed that it was, the same emergency room and the tests, painkillers, anesthesia, cremation were 50,000 HUF. This gang made my dog ​​suffer in Lehel Street for 3 days, they were not even in the picture. Zero expertise, get out of here! Only money robbery

I took my dog ​​for a heart scan and a blood test. Both tests were quick and smooth, the staff was very kind and extremely gentle with my sensitive, fearful puppy. I accidentally asked for the bill in the wrong name, I called in the evening, they immediately changed it and sent it by email. The office is easy to access, the waiting room is spacious and pleasant.

We were on duty this week on 03. 23.-. My dog ​​was choking and confused. The doctor on duty treated him along with the waiting dogs, in separate treatment rooms. He received comprehensive care.
I miss one thing, so afterwards she did not tell me how big the problem was, but rather rescheduled for the next day.
I would like to thank DR. VIVIEN MIHÁLYI for explaining in detail what the problem was with my dog ​​and why it could no longer be helped, so that I could understand it as a layman. She made it easier to make the painful decision.

In parentheses, I would like to note that we also visited the University of Veterinary Medicine and recently the PrimaVet clinic. The latter had a blood test in February. I was informed that there was no particular difference compared to the previous one. While the normal range for liver ALKP was 23-212 U/l, the dog's was 7559 U/l.
Why couldn't this be said?
It doesn't matter anymore, I lost Fanni.
Everyone was very kind and helpful. The examination was thorough.

Today we brought in a stray kitten that was left on the side of the road… It was still breathing, so there was no question of bringing it in. They welcomed us as soon as we entered and we can only thank the doctor and the staff here!🤍 Let's thank them for what they did, we recommend this place from the bottom of our hearts! …
All the employees are very nice and friendly.
Politeness, cleanliness, kindness to animals, and professional expertise are what I have experienced many times.
We were on night duty with our cat. They examined his problematic leg very thoroughly. Thank you very much.
Everyone is very helpful, attentive and very human. Dr. Balázs Bende was our doctor and I can only recommend him.

We took our little dog Mici to the vet with anemia and other major problems. He was in great pain from Saturday afternoon until Monday afternoon, but we had to leave him there. He underwent blood transfusions and other treatments, but they always kept us informed about everything, even sending us pictures to see if our little dog was okay. We spent a lot of time in the clinic, so we saw that they open the door every minute with minor and major problems. The doctors are saving the little dogs without stopping. The negative commenters should think about this. Obviously everyone has their own biggest worries, but they are trying to set up an emergency order. We are completely satisfied. They saved our little dog. Today, Monday the 16th, Mici was released home. He is very grateful to him, and we are very grateful too!!🙏❤️🐶

I’m so relieved that there are veterinarians I can trust. I tried many vets here in Budapest when I first got here with my dogs. This is the place where we decided to settle! Very kind and honest but still very skillful veterinarians here. Special thanks to Dr. Andrea🍀, Balasz, Tamas, and Judit. …
Jerky doctors, sloppy work, anyone who knows should avoid this place, they infected our dog.
This is not the first time they have rescued our pet, they are very kind and helpful to both the owner and the animals! I would trust them with the safety of my pet anytime!
Huter veterinarian, nice staff
Very kind, precise and competent people work here. I can only recommend it to everyone.
Dr. Vrabély is a very good doctor, both professionally and personally.

Damn expensive! One time about 90000 HUF
But if nothing happens it's also 55000 HUF

They are very kind, prepared.
They are expensive, but on the weekend you are glad that there is a possibility of care. Animal medicine is much better than human healthcare.

We arrived from Miskolc at around 3 am yesterday. There was no emergency phone service, so I didn't know if they could take us at all, but I would have waited anyway, if they couldn't take us right away, just to get to a doctor, because there is no 24-hour emergency service anywhere else in the country. They were able to take us in right away and treat my dog, who was bleeding, and cleaned up after us without a word. They were kind, even at 3 am, even though they must have been tired. I don't understand the negative comments when we should be happy that there is an emergency doctor at all. Everyone's own dog is the most important thing, but you have to be patient. I am extremely satisfied with their work and how they were able to help us, so I went at dawn. The next day, Dr. Ákos Horváth called me to inquire about my dog's condition. Fortunately, Menta is much better. I am grateful for the work and kindness of the Doctor and his assistant. I hope 24/7 support will be available in more parts of the country as soon as possible so that we don't have to travel so much, but it was definitely worth the trip. Respect to the whole team. <3
Detailed examination, observation and follow-up check-up! It was a lifesaver!
It has its own parking space in the yard.

I will try to describe my experience without emotion, limiting myself to the facts, why I will never bring any of my animals here again!

We arrived on Saturday afternoon with my 4-year-old, previously completely healthy and playful Vizsla, who suddenly showed signs of severe pain. He was not eating or drinking. His symptoms were as follows: stomach tremors, heavy drooling, shaking, fever, very depressed mood, signs of dehydration, and inflammation of his right eye. The feeling of unwellness began during a walk on Margaret Island, so I suspected poisoning.

Upon arrival, they recorded our data and then we waited. Patients kept arriving after us, and four animals were called in before us, all of whom arrived later. Several of them were still in good, playful condition, while my dog ​​had been very depressed and sick for half a day.
At that time, I asked the receptionist what the order was based on. The answer was that the doctor categorizes cases from the back, and my dog ​​is probably not considered life-threatening. I indicated that I know my dog, and that he is in very bad condition, but I was told that there is nothing they can do, they probably won't call him in for a while, and if others come, they may also be called in before us, so they can't tell me the time...

The style of communication was phlegmatic and devoid of compassion for me. It was downright rude. In the end, I decided to take him somewhere else.
My decision was not only based on my lack of trust in the doctor, who was constantly pushing my dog ​​back without being seen, but rather my entire experience so far.

At another animal hospital - where we arrived as the 12th - he was immediately treated OUT OF LINE, because there was a risk of dehydration. During the examination, it turned out that a walnut-sized tumor was pressing on his oral cavity, which prevented him from eating and drinking, and the tumor was also putting pressure on his eye, which caused inflammation. He was immediately given antibiotics, steroids, and then a more detailed examination was performed under anesthesia.
The next day, he went to the Veterinary University for an MRI.

The tumor was so large that they noticed it as soon as we arrived and someone looked into his mouth, which the Lehel út hospital was unable to do!

I am writing all this because the quality of care and the attitude were incomparable. Wherever we went, we received attention, quick response, and real help for the suffering animal.

Unfortunately, based on my experience at the Lehel út Animal Hospital, I cannot recommend the institution. The communication and attitude were not appropriate for me. We will definitely not come back here.
